summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its condensed consolidated interim financial statements and statutory audit committee report for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus board and syndic listings and share capital detail (1,513,770,222 ordinary shares, 15,525,178 treasury). Pricing, stake, and premium terms are absent. No transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. Revenue rose to ARS 1.79 trillion versus ARS 783.6 billion, with operating profit of ARS 517.6 billion. A periodic reporting event, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
